findings.title: HTTP Security Headers
findings.description: 6 security header issue(s) detected.
findings.evidence:
• [HIGH] Strict-Transport-Security is missing. HSTS header missing — site is vulnerable to protocol downgrade attacks. -> 🛡️ HSTS (HTTP Strict Transport Security):
   # app/Http/Middleware/TrustProxies.php:
   'Strict-Transport-Security' => 'max-age=31536000; includeSubDomains'

   # Nginx:
   add_header Strict-Transport-Security "max-age=31536000; includeSubDomains";

   # .htaccess:
   Header always set Strict-Transport-Security "max-age=31536000; includeSubDomains"
• [MEDIUM] X-Frame-Options is missing. Missing X-Frame-Options — site may be clickjackable. -> 🛡️ X-Frame-Options (Clickjacking koruması):
   # Nginx:
   add_header X-Frame-Options "SAMEORIGIN";

   # Laravel (Bootstrap/app.php):
   'X-Frame-Options' => 'SAMEORIGIN',

   # Veya CSP frame-ancestors kullan:
   'Content-Security-Policy' => "frame-ancestors 'self'"
• [MEDIUM] X-Content-Type-Options is missing. Missing X-Content-Type-Options — MIME-sniffing attacks possible. -> 🛡️ X-Content-Type-Options:
   # Nginx:
   add_header X-Content-Type-Options "nosniff";

   # Laravel:
   'X-Content-Type-Options' => 'nosniff'
• [MEDIUM] Content-Security-Policy is missing. No Content-Security-Policy — XSS and data injection risks elevated. -> 🛡️ Content-Security-Policy (CSP) - En güçlü koruma:
   # Başlangıç (relaxed):
   'Content-Security-Policy' => "default-src 'self'; script-src 'self' 'unsafe-inline'; style-src 'self' 'unsafe-inline'"

   # İleri (strict):
   'Content-Security-Policy' => "default-src 'self'; script-src 'self'; style-src 'self'; img-src 'self' data:; font-src 'self'"

   # Laravel MIX (vite.config.js):
   // CSP plugin ile Vite

🔗 Ref: https://content-security-policy.com/
• [LOW] Referrer-Policy is missing. Missing Referrer-Policy — referrer leakage possible. -> 🛡️ Referrer-Policy:
   # Laravel:
   'Referrer-Policy' => 'strict-origin-when-cross-origin'

   # Nginx:
   add_header Referrer-Policy "strict-origin-when-cross-origin";
• [LOW] Permissions-Policy is missing. Missing Permissions-Policy — browser feature access not restricted. -> 🛡️ Permissions-Policy (Browser features kısıtlama):
   # Laravel:
   'Permissions-Policy' => 'camera=(), microphone=(), geolocation=()'

   # Nginx:
   add_header Permissions-Policy "camera=(), microphone=(), geolocation=();"
findings.remediation: Review and add missing headers in your web server config or Laravel middleware (e.g. `app/Http/Middleware/SecurityHeaders.php`).

findings.title: CORS Misconfiguration
findings.description: CORS misconfiguration(s) detected: CORS headers present but incomplete restrictions. These configurations can allow unauthorized cross-origin access to sensitive data.
findings.evidence:
Endpoint:  | Allowed-Methods: not set
Endpoint: /api | Allowed-Methods: not set
Endpoint: /api/user | Allowed-Methods: not set
Endpoint: /auth | Allowed-Methods: not set
findings.remediation:
⚠️ MEDIUM: CORS misconfiguration! Cross-origin attack riski!

🛡️ 1. Wildcard YASAK (*):
   # ❌ Yanlış:
   'allowed_origins' => ['*'],  # credentials ile!

   # ✅ Doğru:
   'allowed_origins' => ['https://app.example.com'],

🛡️ 2. Credential ile:
   # credentials varsa * çalışmaz, spesifik domain şart
   'supports_credentials' => true ise:
       'allowed_origins' => ['https://example.com'],

🛡️ 3. Methods kısıtla:
   'allowed_methods' => ['GET', 'POST'],

🛡️ 4. Laravel config:
   # config/cors.php:
   'paths' => ['api/*'],
   'allowed_methods' => ['GET', 'POST'],

🛡️ 5. SameSite Cookie:
   'samesite' => 'Strict',  # CSRF ek koruma

🔗 Ref: https://developer.mozilla.org/en-US/docs/Web/HTTP/CORS
